Tangents from an External Point, Class 10 board exam: tangents wala proof dekh ke tension? Figure banao, RHS lagao, step by step.

• Draw it: circle with centre O, external point P, tangents PQ and PR
• Join OQ, OR and OP
• Tangent ⟂ radius, so ∠OQP = ∠ORP = 90°
• OQ = OR (radii), OP common: ΔOQP ≅ ΔORP by RHS
• So PQ = PR by CPCT, hence proved
